text:
1. **Scope — entire PR bundles unrelated work.** The description claims a minimal, focused fix to `MinAppPage.tsx`, but the diff also adds a new Shortcuts-Help modal (`ShortcutsHelp.tsx`), 9 new tab-switching shortcuts + their registration in `Navbar.tsx`/`store/shortcuts.ts`, a full i18n restructuring of `settings.shortcuts.*`, and a stray `PR_TEMPLATE.md`. Fix: split into separate PRs — this PR should contain only the `MinAppPage.tsx` navbar-cache fix; the shortcuts-help feature should be its own PR with its own review.

2. **`en-us.json`/`zh-cn.json`/`zh-tw.json`/etc. — removes actively-used translation keys.** The diff deletes `settings.shortcuts.{action, actions, clear_shortcut, clear_topic, copy_last_message, label, title, reset_defaults, reset_to_default, show_app, show_settings, zoom_in, zoom_out, ...}` from every locale. These keys are almost certainly still consumed by the existing Shortcuts settings page (not touched in this diff), so that page will render blank/fallback strings in all languages. Fix: do not remove these keys unless the consuming component is updated in the same PR to stop using them; otherwise restore them.

3. **`label.ts` / locale files — new keys without translations.** `switch_tab_1..9` and `show_shortcuts_help` are added to `shortcutKeyMap` (pointing at `settings.shortcuts.switch_tab_1` etc.), but no corresponding strings were added to any locale JSON. This will fail the project's i18n consistency check and show missing/raw keys in the UI despite the PR checklist claiming "i18n" passed. Fix: add the missing translation entries for every locale touched.

4. **`PR_TEMPLATE.md` at repo root.** This looks like a leftover scratch file from the agent's own workflow, not a real project artifact, and duplicates the PR description verbatim. Fix: remove it before merge.

5. **`store/shortcuts.ts` — new default-enabled global shortcuts (Ctrl+1–9, Ctrl+/) with no conflict check.** These are silently turned on for all existing users on upgrade, with no check against platform/browser-reserved combos or other app shortcuts, and no scoping (e.g., should probably not fire while typing in an input). Fix: verify no collisions, consider `enabled: false` by default or scoping to non-input focus, and call this out explicitly as a new feature (ties back to point 1).

6. **`ShortcutsHelp.tsx` — `useState(() => { ShortcutsHelpService.setshowFunction(show) })` used as a mount side effect.** Calling `useState` with an initializer purely for its one-time side effect is an anti-pattern (fragile under StrictMode/concurrent rendering, misleading to readers) and the module-level `showShortcutsHelp` singleton is never cleared on unmount, risking a stale closure if the container ever unmounts/remounts. Fix: use `useEffect` for registration and reset the singleton to `null` on cleanup.

7. **`ShortcutsHelp.tsx` — loose typing (`any[]`, `theme: any`).** `renderShortcutCategory(title: string, shortcuts: any[])` and `styled(Modal)<{ theme: any }>` bypass the type system in a codebase that otherwise has a `Shortcut`/theme type available. Fix: use the proper shortcut type and the project's theme type instead of `any`.

8. **`MinAppPage.tsx` — new auto-redirect-on-mode-switch behavior isn't called out as a behavior change.** Resetting `hasHandledRedirect` on every `isTopNavbar` change means that toggling from top-nav to sidebar mode while a mini-app tab is mounted will now automatically `navigate('/apps')` and auto-open a popup, not just on initial mount. This may be intended per the "switching top to sidebar works" test claim, but it's a user-visible behavior change beyond "fix caching" and should be explicitly described/reviewed, not just implied by the diff.
